integrity: Exact analytical counting proof and independently organized finite exact-rational exhaustive tests; no independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The result does not claim induced-motif formulas, stochastic association, independence, or an independently verified historical-priority assignment. Edge-mean degeneracies are excluded from strict signs.
scientific_scope: Exact finite-sample mixed moment between isolated-vertex and non-induced motif counts in uniform simple graphs with fixed edge count, all admissible graph sizes and nondegenerate edge counts.
title: Fixed-edge motif–isolation covariance has an edge-count-invariant sign
